task.description:
Step 5 — run the tests for ISS-0125.

Pre-checks (run before any test):
1. Backend services check:
   - Keycloak at http://localhost:8081/health/ready — should be UP (the ADHOC step brought them up).
   - DB at $BPM_TEST_DB_URL — should be UP.
2. Infrastructure Health Checklist (INV-TI-1):
   - zig build migrate exits 0
   - psql $BPM_TEST_DB_URL -c "SELECT count(*) FROM public.schema_migrations" matches the count of *.sql files in migrations/ (allowing for GBL-prefix skipped-for-non-public).
   - python tools/lint_test_isolation.py tests/integration/iss0125_cascade_test.zig — exit 0
3. Benchmark env: zig build bench 2>&1 | head -5 — should exit 0 with benchmark numbers (no 'BPM_DB_URL', 'BENCHMARK_SETUP_ERROR', or 'missing' in output).

If pre-checks fail: STOP and return FAIL with BLOCKER severity listing which check failed.

Run tests:
- Run the new regression test: zig build test-integration-iss0125 (if a target exists) or the closest match. If no such target, run the full test-integration target and verify the new test runs.
- Also re-run the four affected test files to confirm the surfacing tests pass:
   - tests/integration/iss202_merge_atomicity_test.zig
   - tests/integration/iss203_idempotency_keys_test.zig
   - tests/integration/iss601_state_snapshots_test.zig
   - tests/integration/event_store_test.zig
  (These may run as part of test-integration.)

Write results to tests/reports/report-<date>-WF03-gh391-20260801.yaml per the test guide §9 format.

Complete the handoff with PASS only if:
- All pre-checks pass
- All four test files run without C23503 errors
- The new iss0125_cascade_test.zig tests all PASS

Otherwise FAIL with full issue list and severity classification.

If tests fail: per the project rule, do NOT stop at reporting. Diagnose root cause, and if the failure is in test-cleanup logic or migration, fix and rerun. Otherwise route the failure to the appropriate agent (BACKEND-DEV) via ORCH escalation.
acceptance_criteria: All pre-checks pass (DB up, Keycloak up, zig build migrate clean, bench env clean)
Four affected test files (iss202, iss203, iss601, event_store) all PASS without C23503 errors
